family: SPEEDIO R-Xd1 two-face quick-turn-table machining center
architecture: Vertical BT30 spindle over a 0/180 deg quick turn table (two faces, worm-gear driven by 1 kW servo, 1/50) that swaps the machining face and the load face. Which unit carries X/Y/Z is not stated on the fetched page (memory says table X on Y saddle with Z head on fixed column for SPEEDIO S/W, unverified).

coolant.notes: CTS optional (BT dual-contact spindle used with CTS)

options: 10,000 rpm high-torque spindle (12.8/9.2 kW, 92 N·m, 26.2 kW max output)
hydraulic rotary joint (Y travel then 290 mm on R450)
notes: Pallet = two faces of the turn table; table dimension per face 600 x 420, work area per face 600 x 300; change (position) time 2.7 s at 120 kg per face. Max turning dia D1,020 (D1,100 with low table); max jig height 300 (380 low table). Load 120 kg/face (200 by parameter). Low table: nose-to-table 280-585. Table change repeatability 0.005 mm. Tool-to-tool 0.6/0.7 s (14 / 22-28 tools), chip-to-chip 1.3/1.5. Floor space 1,400 x 2,609 (3,448 door open). Successor R450Xd2 also listed on site (not read).
